+name: Ascend GRPO FSDP2 host memory diagnostic
+
+on:
+  pull_request:
+  workflow_dispatch:
+    inputs:
+      kernel_trace:
+        description: Attempt bounded private kernel tracing (requires existing tracefs access)
+        type: boolean
+        default: true
+
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+
+jobs:
+  grpo_memory:
+    runs-on: linux-aarch64-a3-800i-16
+    timeout-minutes: 180
+    container:
+      image: swr.cn-southwest-2.myhuaweicloud.com/modelfoundry/ascend-ci/verl/verl:latest-vllm-a3-ubuntu
+      options: --shm-size 80g
+    env:
+      HF_DATASETS_CACHE: /root/.cache/temp/hf-datasets
+      MEGATRON_CONFIG_LOCK_DIR: /root/.cache/temp/megatron-config-locks
+      HF_ENDPOINT: https://hf-mirror.com
+      HF_HUB_ENABLE_HF_TRANSFER: "0"
+      PIP_INDEX_URL: http://cache-service.nginx-pypi-cache.svc.cluster.local/pypi/simple
+      PIP_TRUSTED_HOST: cache-service.nginx-pypi-cache.svc.cluster.local
+      MODEL_PATH: /root/.cache/modelscope/hub/models/Qwen/Qwen3.5-2B
+      TRANSFORMERS_VERBOSITY: error
+      PYTHONUNBUFFERED: "1"
+      ASCEND_PROCESS_LOG_PATH: ${{ github.workspace }}/grpo-memory-artifacts/ascend
+      VERL_ASCEND_MEMORY_DIAGNOSTICS: ${{ github.workspace }}/grpo-memory-artifacts/grpo
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+        with:
+          fetch-depth: 0
+          clean: true
+      - name: Record environment before installation
+        shell: bash
+        run: |
+          mkdir -p grpo-memory-artifacts/ascend
+          date -u --iso-8601=seconds > grpo-memory-artifacts/start.txt
+          hostname > grpo-memory-artifacts/hostname.txt
+          git rev-parse HEAD > grpo-memory-artifacts/revision.txt
+          pip list > grpo-memory-artifacts/packages-before.txt
+          cat /usr/local/Ascend/driver/version.info > grpo-memory-artifacts/driver-version.txt 2>&1 || true
+          cat /usr/local/Ascend/ascend-toolkit/latest/"$(uname -i)"-linux/ascend_toolkit_install.info \
+            > grpo-memory-artifacts/cann-version.txt 2>&1 || true
+          npu-smi info > grpo-memory-artifacts/npu-before.txt 2>&1 || true
+          sha256sum verl/utils/ascend_memory_diagnostics.py verl/utils/ascend_kernel_trace.py \
+            verl/workers/engine_workers.py tests/special_npu/nightly_ci_ascend/run_grpo_qwen3_5_2b_fsdp2_npu.sh \
+            > grpo-memory-artifacts/source-hashes.txt
+      - name: Prepare the nightly GRPO workload
+        shell: bash
+        run: |
+          set -o pipefail
+          pip install -v -e . 2>&1 | tee grpo-memory-artifacts/install.log
+          pip list > grpo-memory-artifacts/packages-after.txt
+          python3 examples/data_preprocess/geo3k.py --local_dataset_path "${HOME}/.cache/modelscope/dataset/hiyouga/geometry3k"
+      - name: Run unchanged GRPO with actor initialization diagnostics
+        shell: bash
+        env:
+          ENABLE_KERNEL_TRACE: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' || inputs.kernel_trace }}
+        run: |
+          set -o pipefail
+          ray stop --force
+          trace_args=()
+          if [ "$ENABLE_KERNEL_TRACE" != "true" ]; then trace_args+=(--disabled); fi
+          python3 verl/utils/ascend_kernel_trace.py --output grpo-memory-artifacts/kernel-trace "${trace_args[@]}" -- \
+            python3 verl/utils/ascend_memory_diagnostics.py --output "$VERL_ASCEND_MEMORY_DIAGNOSTICS" --expected-actors 4 -- \
+            bash tests/special_npu/nightly_ci_ascend/run_grpo_qwen3_5_2b_fsdp2_npu.sh \
+            "++ray_kwargs.ray_init.runtime_env.env_vars.VERL_ASCEND_MEMORY_DIAGNOSTICS=$VERL_ASCEND_MEMORY_DIAGNOSTICS" \
+            "++ray_kwargs.ray_init.runtime_env.env_vars.ASCEND_PROCESS_LOG_PATH=$ASCEND_PROCESS_LOG_PATH" \
+            2>&1 | tee grpo-memory-artifacts/console.log
+      - name: Preserve final diagnostics
+        if: always()
+        shell: bash
+        run: |
+          mkdir -p grpo-memory-artifacts
+          python3 verl/utils/ascend_kernel_trace.py --output grpo-memory-artifacts/kernel-trace --stop || true
+          timeout 20s dmesg -T > grpo-memory-artifacts/kernel-final.txt 2>&1 || true
+          timeout 20s journalctl -k --utc --since '-180 minutes' --no-pager \
+            > grpo-memory-artifacts/kernel-journal.txt 2>&1 || true
+          if [ -d /tmp/ray/session_latest/logs ]; then
+            timeout 60s tar -czf grpo-memory-artifacts/ray-logs.tar.gz -C /tmp/ray/session_latest logs || true
+          fi
+          date -u --iso-8601=seconds > grpo-memory-artifacts/end.txt
+      - name: Upload diagnostic evidence
+        if: always()
+        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
+        with:
+          name: ascend-grpo-memory-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
+          path: grpo-memory-artifacts/
+          retention-days: 14
+          if-no-files-found: warn

+"""Optional, bounded tracefs collection around a CI command; no mounts or kprobes.
+
+The ring is host-wide, so unrelated events are possible. mm_page_alloc supplies
+GFP flags and stacks but not the requested NUMA node. Trace PIDs may be host
+PIDs invisible in the container. Save formats, clocks and overrun statistics;
+do not infer absence of failures from an unavailable or overwritten trace.
+"""
+
+import argparse
+import json
+import os
+import re
+import shutil
+import subprocess
+import threading
+import time
+import uuid
+from pathlib import Path
+
+TRACE_ROOTS = (Path("/sys/kernel/tracing"), Path("/sys/kernel/debug/tracing"))
+
+
+def status(output, **values):
+    path = output / "status.json"
+    previous = json.loads(path.read_text()) if path.exists() else {}
+    path.write_text(json.dumps({**previous, **values, "updated_unix_ns": time.time_ns()}, indent=2))
+
+
+def stop(output):
+    """Only stop/remove the private instance recorded by this run; safe to repeat."""
+    state = output / "instance.json"
+    if not state.exists():
+        return
+    data = json.loads(state.read_text())
+    root = Path(data["root"])
+    name = data["name"]
+    if root not in TRACE_ROOTS or not re.fullmatch(r"verl_mem_[0-9a-f]{32}", name):
+        raise ValueError("Refusing to touch an unrecognized trace instance")
+    instance = root / "instances" / name
+    if not instance.exists():
+        return
+    # Disable even if output collection subsequently fails.
+    (instance / "tracing_on").write_text("0")
+    try:
+        with (instance / "trace").open("rb") as source, (output / "trace.txt").open("wb") as target:
+            shutil.copyfileobj(source, target)
+        stats = {p.parent.name: p.read_text() for p in instance.glob("per_cpu/cpu*/stats")}
+        (output / "buffer-stats.json").write_text(json.dumps(stats, indent=2))
+        status(output, stopped=True, stop_monotonic_ns=time.monotonic_ns())
+    finally:
+        event = instance / "events/kmem/mm_page_alloc"
+        if event.is_dir():
+            (event / "enable").write_text("0")
+            if "stacktrace" in (event / "trigger").read_text():
+                (event / "trigger").write_text("!stacktrace")
+        instance.rmdir()  # tracefs removes its virtual children; never recursive delete
+
+
+def start(output):
+    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    status(output, available=False, started=False)
+    try:
+        if os.sysconf("SC_PAGE_SIZE") != 4096:
+            raise RuntimeError("Order-9 diagnostic requires 4 KiB base pages")
+        root = next(p for p in TRACE_ROOTS if (p / "instances").is_dir())
+        name = "verl_mem_" + uuid.uuid4().hex
+        instance = root / "instances" / name
+        # Record ownership before creating anything, for always-run cleanup.
+        (output / "instance.json").write_text(json.dumps({"root": str(root), "name": name}))
+        instance.mkdir()
+        (instance / "tracing_on").write_text("0")
+        (instance / "buffer_size_kb").write_text("128")  # per CPU, ~40 MiB on a 320-CPU host
+        (instance / "trace_clock").write_text("mono")
+        event = instance / "events/kmem/mm_page_alloc"
+        (output / "event-format.txt").write_text((event / "format").read_text())
+        condition = "order == 9 && pfn == 18446744073709551615"
+        (event / "filter").write_text(condition)
+        (event / "trigger").write_text("stacktrace if " + condition)
+        (event / "enable").write_text("1")
+        for filename, path in {
+            "filter.txt": event / "filter",
+            "trigger.txt": event / "trigger",
+            "clock.txt": instance / "trace_clock",
+            "buffer-total-kb.txt": instance / "buffer_total_size_kb",
+        }.items():
+            (output / filename).write_text(path.read_text())
+        status(output, available=True, started=True, start_monotonic_ns=time.monotonic_ns())
+        (instance / "tracing_on").write_text("1")
+    except Exception as exc:
+        status(output, available=False, error=repr(exc))
+        try:
+            stop(output)
+        except Exception as cleanup:
+            status(output, cleanup_error=repr(cleanup))
+        print(f"Kernel tracing unavailable: {exc!r}", flush=True)
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("--output", required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--stop", action="store_true")
+    parser.add_argument("--disabled", action="store_true", help="Record a passive run without touching tracefs")
+    parser.add_argument("command", nargs=argparse.REMAINDER)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    output = Path(args.output).resolve()
+    if args.stop:
+        stop(output)
+        return 0
+    command = args.command[1:] if args.command[:1] == ["--"] else args.command
+    if not command:
+        parser.error("a workload command is required after --")
+    if args.disabled:
+        output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        status(output, available=False, started=False, disabled=True)
+    else:
+        start(output)
+    lock = threading.Lock()
+
+    def finish():
+        with lock:
+            try:
+                stop(output)
+            except Exception as exc:
+                print(f"Kernel trace cleanup failed: {exc!r}", flush=True)
+                try:
+                    status(output, cleanup_error=repr(exc))
+                except OSError:
+                    pass  # Preserve the workload result even if artifact storage is full.
+
+    # Cap duration independently of workload progress. SIGKILL needs the CI
+    # always-run cleanup step; loss of the entire runner still needs host cleanup.
+    timer = threading.Timer(80 * 60, finish)
+    timer.daemon = True
+    timer.start()
+    try:
+        result = subprocess.call(command)
+        return result if result >= 0 else 128 - result
+    finally:
+        timer.cancel()
+        finish()
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+"""Opt-in, stdlib-only diagnostics for Ascend GRPO actor initialization.
+
+Run this file directly to monitor the unchanged GRPO command on a Linux CI node.
+Snapshots add latency and can perturb allocation timing. Never alter allocation
+arguments, retry a failed allocation, or suppress the original exception.
+"""
+
+import argparse
+import datetime
+import json
+import os
+import socket
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import threading
+import time
+import traceback
+from contextlib import contextmanager
+from pathlib import Path
+
+CGROUP_FILES = (
+    "memory.current",
+    "memory.max",
+    "memory.high",
+    "memory.peak",
+    "memory.events",
+    "memory.events.local",
+    "memory.stat",
+    "memory.numa_stat",
+    "memory.pressure",
+    "memory.swap.current",
+    "memory.swap.max",
+    "memory.swap.events",
+    "memory.limit_in_bytes",
+    "memory.usage_in_bytes",
+    "memory.max_usage_in_bytes",
+    "memory.failcnt",
+    "memory.oom_control",
+    "memory.memsw.limit_in_bytes",
+    "memory.memsw.usage_in_bytes",
+    "memory.memsw.failcnt",
+    "memory.use_hierarchy",
+    "cpuset.mems",
+    "cpuset.mems.effective",
+    "cpuset.effective_mems",
+    "cpuset.cpus",
+    "cpuset.cpus.effective",
+    "cpuset.effective_cpus",
+)
+
+
+def now():
+    return datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
+
+
+def read(path):
+    try:
+        return Path(path).read_text()
+    except OSError as exc:
+        return f"UNAVAILABLE: {exc}\n"
+
+
+def thread_memory_policy():
+    """Read this thread's default NUMA policy without changing it."""
+    import ctypes
+
+    try:
+        library = ctypes.CDLL("libnuma.so.1", use_errno=True)
+        query = library.get_mempolicy
+        query.argtypes = [
+            ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_int),
+            ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_ulong),
+            ctypes.c_ulong,
+            ctypes.c_void_p,
+            ctypes.c_ulong,
+        ]
+        query.restype = ctypes.c_int
+        possible = Path("/sys/devices/system/node/possible").read_text().strip()
+        max_node = max(int(part.split("-")[-1]) for part in possible.split(",")) + 1
+        bits = ctypes.sizeof(ctypes.c_ulong) * 8
+        words = (max_node + bits - 1) // bits
+        mask = (ctypes.c_ulong * words)()
+        mode = ctypes.c_int()
+        if query(ctypes.byref(mode), mask, words * bits, None, 0):
+            raise OSError(ctypes.get_errno(), "get_mempolicy failed")
+        return {"mode": mode.value, "nodes": [i for i in range(max_node) if mask[i // bits] & (1 << (i % bits))]}
+    except Exception as exc:
+        return {"unavailable": repr(exc)}
+
+
+def snapshot(destination, detailed=True):
+    destination.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    for name in (
+        "meminfo",
+        "buddyinfo",
+        "vmstat",
+        "self/status",
+        "thread-self/status",
+        "thread-self/sched",
+        "self/limits",
+        "self/cgroup",
+        "self/mountinfo",
+    ):
+        (destination / name.replace("/", "_")).write_text(read("/proc/" + name))
+    if detailed:
+        (destination / "pagetypeinfo").write_text(read("/proc/pagetypeinfo"))
+        (destination / "self_numa_maps").write_text(read("/proc/self/numa_maps"))
+        (destination / "thread-memory-policy.json").write_text(json.dumps(thread_memory_policy(), indent=2))
+    for node in Path("/sys/devices/system/node").glob("node[0-9]*"):
+        (destination / (node.name + "_meminfo")).write_text(read(node / "meminfo"))
+    (destination / "cgroups.json").write_text(json.dumps(cgroup_snapshot(), indent=2))
+    (destination / "timestamp.txt").write_text(now() + "\nAncestors above cgroup mount root may be hidden.\n")
+
+
+def cgroup_snapshot(pid="self"):
+    """Resolve memberships against this collector's mounts only in shared namespaces."""
+    if pid != "self":
+        try:
+            for namespace in ("mnt", "cgroup"):
+                if os.readlink(f"/proc/{pid}/ns/{namespace}") != os.readlink(f"/proc/self/ns/{namespace}"):
+                    return [
+                        {"unavailable": f"worker {pid} has a different {namespace} namespace; see worker snapshots"}
+                    ]
+        except OSError as exc:
+            return [{"unavailable": repr(exc)}]
+    membership = read(f"/proc/{pid}/cgroup")
+    if membership.startswith("UNAVAILABLE:"):
+        return [{"unavailable": membership}]
+    memberships = [line.split(":", 2) for line in membership.splitlines() if line.count(":") == 2]
+    groups = []
+    for line in read("/proc/self/mountinfo").splitlines():
+        if " - " not in line:
+            continue
+        left, right = line.split(" - ", 1)
+        fields, fs = left.split(), right.split()
+        if fs[0] not in ("cgroup", "cgroup2"):
+            continue
+
+        def unescape(value):
+            for code, char in (("\\040", " "), ("\\011", "\t"), ("\\012", "\n"), ("\\134", "\\")):
+                value = value.replace(code, char)
+            return value
+
+        root, mount = map(unescape, fields[3:5])
+        for _, controllers, group in memberships:
+            if fs[0] == "cgroup2" and controllers:
+                continue
+            if fs[0] == "cgroup" and not (set(controllers.split(",")) & {"memory", "cpuset"} & set(fs[2].split(","))):
+                continue
+            group = unescape(group)
+            relative = os.path.relpath(group, root)
+            target = Path(mount) / relative if relative != ".." and not relative.startswith("../") else Path(mount)
+            mapping = "resolved" if target != Path(mount) or group == root else "mount-root fallback"
+            if not target.is_dir():
+                target = Path(mount)
+                mapping = "mount-root fallback; exact membership unavailable"
+            while True:
+                entry = {"path": str(target), "mount_root": root, "membership": group, "mapping": mapping}
+                for name in CGROUP_FILES:
+                    item = target / name
+                    if item.exists():
+                        entry[name] = read(item)
+                groups.append(entry)
+                if target == Path(mount):
+                    break
+                target = target.parent
+    return groups
+
+
+def capture(folder, name, command):
+    try:
+        result = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=20)
+        output = f"exit={result.returncode}\n{result.stdout}{result.stderr}"
+    except (OSError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired) as exc:
+        output = f"UNAVAILABLE: {exc}"
+    (folder / name).write_text(output)
+
+
+def record(folder, detailed=None, **details):
+    """Diagnostic failures must not replace a workload exception."""
+    try:
+        folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        details.update(
+            time=now(),
+            monotonic_ns=time.monotonic_ns(),
+            pid=os.getpid(),
+            ppid=os.getppid(),
+            tid=threading.get_native_id(),
+            hostname=socket.gethostname(),
+        )
+        # Preserve the event/exception even if a later procfs read fails.
+        (folder / "event.json").write_text(json.dumps(details, indent=2, default=str))
+        snapshot(
+            folder,
+            detailed=folder.name in {"installed", "failed", "initial", "final"} if detailed is None else detailed,
+        )
+        (folder / "self_maps").write_text(read("/proc/self/maps"))
+    except Exception as exc:
+        print(f"Ascend memory diagnostic failed: {exc!r}", file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
+
+
+@contextmanager
+def actor_initialization():
+    """Observe actor.reset without wrapping tensors, retrying or synchronizing."""
+    root = os.environ.get("VERL_ASCEND_MEMORY_DIAGNOSTICS")
+    if not root:
+        yield
+        return
+    folder = Path(root) / "actor_init" / str(os.getpid()) / str(time.monotonic_ns())
+    record(folder / "before", detailed=True, stage="actor.reset", stack=traceback.format_stack())
+    print(f"ASCEND_MEMORY actor.reset before pid={os.getpid()} tid={threading.get_native_id()}", flush=True)
+    started = time.monotonic()
+    try:
+        yield
+    except BaseException:
+        # Save the original traceback before slower reads; never replace the exception.
+        record(folder / "failed", exception=traceback.format_exc(), elapsed_s=time.monotonic() - started)
+        try:
+            capture(folder / "failed", "kernel.txt", ["dmesg", "-T"])
+        except Exception as exc:
+            print(f"Kernel capture failed: {exc!r}", file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
+        print(f"ASCEND_MEMORY actor.reset failed pid={os.getpid()}", flush=True)
+        raise
+    else:
+        record(folder / "after", elapsed_s=time.monotonic() - started)
+        print(f"ASCEND_MEMORY actor.reset completed pid={os.getpid()}", flush=True)
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
+    parser.add_argument("--output", required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--expected-actors", type=int, default=4)
+    parser.add_argument("command", nargs=argparse.REMAINDER)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    command = args.command[1:] if args.command[:1] == ["--"] else args.command
+    if not command:
+        parser.error("a workload command is required after --")
+    output = Path(args.output).resolve()
+    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
+    os.environ["VERL_ASCEND_MEMORY_DIAGNOSTICS"] = str(output)
+    record(
+        output / "initial",
+        command=command,
+        identity={
+            key: os.environ.get(key, "UNAVAILABLE")
+            for key in (
+                "GITHUB_RUN_ID",
+                "GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT",
+                "GITHUB_SHA",
+                "RUNNER_NAME",
+                "POD_NAME",
+                "NODE_NAME",
+                "K8S_NODE_NAME",
+                "IMAGE_DIGEST",
+            )
+        },
+    )
+    capture(output, "revision.txt", ["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"])
+    capture(output, "packages.txt", [sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "list"])
+    capture(output, "kernel-before.txt", ["dmesg", "-T"])
+    capture(output, "shm.txt", ["df", "-h", "/dev/shm"])
+    capture(output, "npu-smi.txt", ["npu-smi", "info"])
+    stop = threading.Event()
+
+    def sample():
+        sequence = 0
+        while not stop.is_set():
+            folder = output / "host" / f"sample-{sequence:06d}"
+            try:
+                snapshot(folder, detailed=False)
+                (folder / "clock.json").write_text(json.dumps({"time": now(), "monotonic_ns": time.monotonic_ns()}))
+                # Include real actor memberships/status, not only the supervisor's.
+                for actor in (output / "actor_init").glob("[0-9]*"):
+                    for name in ("status", "cgroup"):
+                        (folder / f"actor-{actor.name}-{name}").write_text(read(f"/proc/{actor.name}/{name}"))
+                    (folder / f"actor-{actor.name}-cgroups.json").write_text(
+                        json.dumps(cgroup_snapshot(actor.name), indent=2)
+                    )
+                if sequence % 10 == 0:
+                    mem = read("/proc/meminfo").splitlines()
+                    selected = [line for line in mem if line.startswith(("MemAvailable:", "MemFree:", "Cached:"))]
+                    groups = json.loads((folder / "cgroups.json").read_text())
+                    compact = [
+                        {
+                            k: v
+                            for k, v in g.items()
+                            if k
+                            in (
+                                "path",
+                                "memory.current",
+                                "memory.max",
+                                "memory.usage_in_bytes",
+                                "memory.limit_in_bytes",
+                                "memory.events",
+                                "memory.failcnt",
+                                "memory.oom_control",
+                            )
+                        }
+                        for g in groups
+                    ]
+                    print(f"ASCEND_MEMORY {now()} {'; '.join(selected)} cgroups={json.dumps(compact)}", flush=True)
+            except Exception as exc:
+                print(f"Memory sampling unavailable: {exc!r}", flush=True)
+            sequence += 1
+            # Retain low-frequency monitoring after the target initialization phase.
+            completed = len(list((output / "actor_init").glob("*/*/after/event.json")))
+            stop.wait(5 if completed >= args.expected_actors else 1)
+
+    sampler = threading.Thread(target=sample, daemon=True)
+    sampler.start()
+    result = 1
+    try:
+        result = subprocess.call(command)
+        result = result if result >= 0 else 128 - result
+    finally:
+        stop.set()
+        sampler.join(timeout=10)
+        record(output / "final", exit_code=result)
+    calls = len(list((output / "actor_init").glob("*/*/before/event.json")))
+    completed = len(list((output / "actor_init").glob("*/*/after/event.json")))
+    failures = [str(p.relative_to(output)) for p in (output / "actor_init").glob("*/*/failed/event.json")]
+    summary = {
+        "workload_exit_code": result,
+        "actor_init_calls": calls,
+        "actor_init_completed": completed,
+        "actor_init_failures": failures,
+        "expected_actors": args.expected_actors,
+        "coverage_complete": calls == completed == args.expected_actors and not failures,
+    }
+    # Never label an uninstrumented passing workload a successful diagnostic.
+    diagnostic_result = result or (0 if summary["coverage_complete"] else 2)
+    summary["diagnostic_exit_code"] = diagnostic_result
+    try:
+        (output / "summary.json").write_text(json.dumps(summary, indent=2))
+    except OSError as exc:
+        print(f"Summary write failed: {exc!r}", flush=True)
+    print("ASCEND_MEMORY summary=" + json.dumps(summary), flush=True)
+    return diagnostic_result
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())
